listing.name: I.G.I. 2: Covert Strike / OpenIGI (OpenIGI)
listing.summary: A clean-room reimplementation of the Project I.G.I. and I.G.I. 2 engine in C#/.NET 10. It plays the original missions faithfully, with a modern renderer (D3D12, Vulkan, WebGPU, ray tracing, DLSS), co-op, mods and a launcher.
